Full original Japanese printed face of [[I'm On The Leader (Japanese)]], printing ID <code>1302_133o</code>, in its PSA holder. Original JPEG from PSA Set Registry, retained unchanged. The PSA label says “Evader”; the printed title 先頭機は任せろ, destiny 3, unique marker and game text identify [[I'm On The Leader (Japanese)]].<ref name="source">[https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/tcg/company-sets/1997-decipher-star-wars-ccg-new-hope-limited-japanese/imagegallery/587873 PSA Set Registry source gallery] · [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/156625016/rPfxlw7xtUCleiE5ikW1Iw.jpg Original photograph]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261113165759/https://swccg.com/snapshots/psa/japanese-nine-faces-369-v2.html Internet Archive source photographs], including this unchanged JPEG.</ref>
